# Code of Conduct

We are committed to providing a welcoming, respectful, and technically rigorous open-source community.

## Standards

- Practice constructive, evidence-based technical feedback.
- Report experimental metrics, hardware boundaries, and reproduction gaps honestly (never present proxy metrics or CPU smoke checks as paper-comparable GPU benchmark claims).
- Respect attribution and license terms of upstream research implementations.
- Harassment, discrimination, doxxing, or publishing credentials/private data are unacceptable.

## Enforcement

 Maintainers may remove inappropriate content or restrict participation to protect contributors and users. Report concerns privately to the repository maintainers.
